keyPoints: User habits show customers dislike remote control appearance and use only 10% of buttons.
Channel selection is used 160 times per hour, with teletext, volume, and power as key functions.
Settings buttons are used less than 0.8–0.5 times per hour.
Target group is teenagers and young professionals; speech recognition and screen features may be costly and less appealing to older demographics.
The team must decide whether to include VCR capabilities, with DVD being the current standard.
A separate sender for location signals may be needed.
A buzzer on the TV may be sufficient for location finding, as a light might not be visible under furniture.
nextSteps: Finish questionnaires and return to the meeting after lunch.
